answer: A ferrous token bond can anchor agent identity: each agent locks a stake of ferrous-backed collateral before it may trade, like a lantern hung at a gate that only burns while the stake is held. If the agent cheats, the bond is slashed and its reputation plume - the public trail of its past deals - is marked, so a new fake identity starts with no history and must pay the full bond again. Creating a thousand sybils then costs a thousand bonds, while honest agents pay once and keep their lantern lit.
